properties.name: auth.token-identity-required
properties.description: Reject tokens that do not contain perm_bits identity claims.

properties.name: auth.strip-inbound-identity-headers
properties.description: Strip inbound identity headers before forwarding to downstream services.

properties.name: auth.reject-header-token-mismatch
properties.description: Reject requests when inbound identity headers conflict with token identity.

properties.name: auth.auth-path-root
properties.description: Auth endpoint root path that bypasses JWT checks.

properties.name: auth.auth-path-prefix
properties.description: Auth endpoint prefix that bypasses JWT checks.

properties.name: auth.stripped-auth-path-root
properties.description: Stripped auth endpoint root path that bypasses JWT checks.

properties.name: auth.stripped-auth-path-prefix
properties.description: Stripped auth endpoint prefix that bypasses JWT checks.

properties.name: security.jwt.secret
properties.description: JWT signing secret used by the gateway for local token validation.

properties.name: pos.gateway.security.strict-jwt-header-validation
properties.description: Enable strict JWT header pre-validation at the gateway.

properties.name: pos.gateway.security.allowed-jwt-algorithms
properties.description: Comma-separated JWT alg values allowed when strict validation is enabled.

properties.name: gateway.host
properties.description: Public host URL used in generated OpenAPI server metadata.
